_comment: Human review of what the automatic checkers flagged. Two detectors flag
chart-groundedness problems and neither is trustworthy on its own, so every
flag was read against the engine's own chart output and recorded here.
`reviewed_by` is the engineer who ran the evaluation; the raw text of every
flagged claim is in out/scores.jsonl, so this table can be re-checked.
Add an entry with "real": false to strike a false positive off the report.

deterministic_flags.note: Engine: Venus mahadasha runs 2079-2099. 2018-2020 was Rahu. Invented period.
Engine: Venus mahadasha 2018-01 to 2038-01. Off by sixty years; hedged with 'may have', but stated as the basis of the timing.

judge_contradiction_flags._comment: The judge flags any sentence it reads as contradicting the engine facts it was given. Reviewed one by one.
judge_contradiction_flags.not_real_reason: The judge flagged the agent's own honest disclaimer that the lagna and the dasha start dates are uncertain because the birth time is unknown. That is correct behaviour, not a contradiction.
